notes.title: Mini monster-catching MMO 'Familiars.io' heads to Steam
notes.notes:
Familiars.io is a very retro-styled mini-MMO about catching monsters and battling, and it's now heading to Steam.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/10/mini-monster-catching-mmo-familiarsio-heads-to-steam
